pageDescription: Production-grade agentic architectures, on-device clinical LLMs, multimodal computer vision pipelines, and generative foundation models by MD Saib Hossain.

items.title: MemoryOS — Local LLM Memory Sandbox
items.description: A fully local, multi-user educational sandbox application designed to demonstrate and explore modern LLM memory design patterns using LangGraph checkpointers, PostgresStore persistence, and dynamic Ollama execution.
highlights: Short-term and long-term memory persistence using PostgresStore checkpointers
Dynamic sliding-window context summarization to bypass LLM context limits
Secure multi-user chat isolation with interactive UI and monitoring telemetry

items.title: ScholarAgent — AI Scholarship Advisor
items.description: Autonomous multi-agent AI system for international scholarship discovery, academic profile evaluation, strategic timeline roadmap generation, and automated Statement of Purpose (SOP) drafting.
highlights: Four-agent specialized workflow: Discovery, Profile Matcher, Roadmap Planner, and SOP Drafter
Local LLM orchestration via Ollama eliminating sensitive student data cloud transfer
Real-time CrewAI telemetry, task observability, and PDF export formatting

items.title: Agentic AI Technical Interviewer
items.description: Stateful autonomous AI interviewer that parses candidate resumes, routes intent dynamically, and conducts multi-turn interactive technical coding evaluations with structured rubric scoring.
highlights: Robust state machine preserving conversational loops, follow-up challenges, and hint delivery
Hybrid LLM orchestration supporting both cloud (Gemini 2.5) and local (Ollama) inference
Structured JSON output validation for skill metrics, code quality, and final assessment

items.title: MedAssist-LLM-iPhone (Offline Medical QA)
items.description: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct on medical clinical QA datasets with LoRA, quantized to GGUF format for 100% offline, privacy-preserving on-device inference on iPhone with zero cloud latency.
highlights: 100% offline on-device LLM inference without cloud dependency or network connection
Unsloth + Hugging Face Transformers pipeline for parameter-efficient LoRA tuning
Optimized 4-bit quantization (Q4_K_M) delivering 28.4 tokens/sec on mobile Neural Engines

items.title: Real-Time Vision + LLM Agent (LLM with Eyes)
items.description: Autonomous multimodal computer vision system combining real-time YOLO11 object detection with Gemini 2.5 Flash for high-level contextual reasoning and auditory narration of visual environments.
highlights: Live camera feed processing with spatial bounding box slicing at 60 FPS
High-frequency image patching to Gemini 2.5 Flash for scene description and hazard alerts
Modular pipeline architected for smart assistive glasses and robotic inspection

items.title: Synthetic Face Dataset Generation (GANs + Diffusion)
items.description: Hybrid generative pipeline contrasting StyleGAN2-ADA and Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) with LoRA to study dataset scale and demographic bias mitigation in small-sample visual foundation models.
highlights: Adaptive Discriminator Augmentation (ADA) preventing discriminator overfitting on small datasets
Identity-preserving generation with controlled pose, lighting, and demographic diversity
Quantitative generative consistency benchmark across FID, IS, and perceptual diversity

items.title: LangGraph MCP Agent + XAMPP MySQL Integration
items.description: Modular Model Context Protocol (MCP) server powered by LangGraph with FastAPI backend and MySQL integration for automated SQL query generation, telemetry, and intelligent document indexing.
highlights: Standardized MCP server architecture for seamless agent tool-calling integration
FastAPI asynchronous endpoints executing validated database transactions
Document ingestion pipeline with metadata indexing and semantic search integration

items.title: Bangla Sign Language Translator
items.description: Real-time assistive computer vision system tracking 21 3D hand landmarks via MediaPipe and classifying gestures with CNNs to translate Bangla sign language alphabets into spoken audio.
highlights: Real-time 21-point hand landmark coordinate normalization across diverse lighting
Custom CNN architecture classifying Bangla characters with 98.7% validation accuracy
Integrated Bengali text-to-speech engine deployable on Raspberry Pi and edge hardware

items.title: Googler Search Agent
items.description: Autonomous AI research agent executing multi-turn web search loops, extracting relevant evidence, deduplicating findings, and synthesizing concise executive summaries using local LLMs.
highlights: Autonomous query refinement breaking complex research questions into parallel search facets
On-premise synthesis via Ollama + LangGraph preventing cloud telemetry leakage
Automatic citation indexing and structured Markdown briefing compilation

items.title: Prompt-Based Dynamic LLM Selector
items.description: Intelligent routing gate analyzing incoming prompt complexity, token length, and reasoning depth to dynamically dispatch requests to the optimal local LLM (Gemma 3 vs DeepSeek-R1).
highlights: Dynamic heuristic & semantic prompt complexity classification engine
Compute-aware routing steering simple queries to 4B/8B models and deep logic to 70B clusters
Ollama cluster load-balancing minimizing GPU memory thrashing

items.title: DeepLearning with PyTorch
items.description: Foundational convolutional neural network implementations, automated hyperparameter optimization loops, and custom dataset training pipelines on benchmark visual recognition tasks.
highlights: Production neural network training loops with mixed-precision (AMP) and gradient clipping
Hyperparameter optimization experiments tracked via Weights & Biases telemetry
Modular data transformation pipelines with albumentations and test-time augmentation

items.title: AI-Based Plagiarism Detection
items.description: Privacy-preserving academic text analysis engine measuring token perplexity, burstiness distributions, and statistical entropy to reliably distinguish AI-generated essays from human writing.
highlights: On-device natural language analysis ensuring full privacy of sensitive academic manuscripts
Token-level statistical entropy scoring highlighting specific suspicious synthetic phrases
Lightweight Python execution engine suitable for deployment on campus intranet servers

items.title: AI-Powered Study Assistant Chatbot
items.description: Conversational learning assistant leveraging a fine-tuned GPT-2 model with FastAPI streaming endpoints and a responsive interface for student conceptual Q&A and interactive revision.
highlights: FastAPI asynchronous streaming WebSocket backend delivering instant token-by-token replies
Fine-tuning pipeline tailored for computer science and mathematics pedagogical explanations
Interactive topic quiz and flashcard generation modules for active recall study sessions
